relNote: Each posted GL voucher creates one GeneralJournalEntry header; GeneralJournalAccountEntry holds the debit/credit lines

def.name: GeneralJournalEntry
def.description: Posted GL voucher header table. Every financial posting (AP invoice, AR payment, journal entry, etc.) creates exactly one row here, replacing the legacy LedgerTrans table from AX 2009.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: AccountingDate
fields.note: Date on which the entry is recognised in the GL

fields.name: JournalNumber
fields.note: Subledger journal number (internal posting reference)

fields.name: JournalCategory
fields.note: Enum classifying the journal type (daily, payment, etc.)

fields.name: PostingLayer
fields.note: Enum: Current=0, Operations=1, Tax=2; separates reporting layers

fields.name: Ledger
fields.note: FK to the Ledger table identifying which ledger this entry posts to

fields.name: SubledgerVoucher
fields.note: Voucher number originating from the subledger posting (e.g. AP invoice voucher)

fields.name: DocumentNumber
fields.note: External document reference number from the source document

fields.name: DocumentDate
fields.note: Date on the source document (may differ from AccountingDate)

fields.name: FiscalCalendarPeriod
fields.note: FK to the fiscal calendar period in which this entry is posted

relNote: Individual debit/credit line on a posted GL voucher; FK to GeneralJournalEntry header and to DimensionAttributeValueCombination for the ledger account

def.name: GeneralJournalAccountEntry
def.description: Individual debit or credit line on a posted GL voucher. Each GeneralJournalEntry header has one or more GeneralJournalAccountEntry rows holding the account, amount, posting type, and currency details.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: GeneralJournalEntry
fields.note: FK to the voucher header this line belongs to

fields.name: LedgerDimension
fields.note: FK to the resolved account + financial dimensions combination

fields.name: AccountingCurrencyAmount
fields.note: Amount in the accounting (home) currency of the ledger

fields.name: TransactionCurrencyAmount
fields.note: Amount in the original transaction currency

fields.name: ReportingCurrencyAmount
fields.note: Amount in the reporting currency of the ledger

fields.name: PostingType
fields.note: Enum indicating the posting type (Ledger, Vendor, Customer, Bank, etc.)

fields.name: IsCredit
fields.note: 1 if this line is a credit entry; 0 if a debit entry

fields.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
fields.note: ISO 4217 currency code of the transaction currency

fields.name: MainAccount
fields.note: FK to the MainAccount record (denormalised from LedgerDimension for quick lookup)

def.name: DimensionAttributeValueCombination
def.description: Stores one resolved set of financial dimension values (e.g. MainAccount=1001, Department=10, CostCenter=CC01). Many transaction tables store a LedgerDimension field (Int64) that is an FK to this table's RecId, which is how financial dimensions are attached to ledger entries.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key; referenced by LedgerDimension FK fields across the system

fields.name: DisplayValue
fields.note: Concatenated display string of all dimension values (e.g. '1001-DEPT10-CC01')

fields.name: AccountStructure
fields.note: FK to the account structure (DimensionHierarchy) defining which dimensions apply

fields.name: MainAccount
fields.note: FK to the MainAccount record for the primary account segment

fields.name: MainAccountValue
fields.note: Main account segment value (e.g. '1001'), denormalised for quick access

fields.name: LedgerDimensionType
fields.note: Enum distinguishing the combination type (full ledger account, default dimension, etc.)

fields.name: DataAreaForCreation
fields.note: Legal entity identifier in which this dimension combination was first created
